en: A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing an elevated view over a historic spa town in a wooded valley. In the foreground there is an ornate wrought‑iron balcony with a bench, framed by tree branches. Below, a river or canal with promenades on both sides runs through the center of the town, lined with grand 19th‑century buildings. Distinctive onion‑domed church towers and other historic structures rise above the streets. The word "Karlsbad." is printed in the upper right corner of the image area.
